assessment: This seminal paper describes the divergent effects of Rspo3 haploinsufficiency on appendicular versus the axial skeletal in mice and, in doing so, highlights the differential regulation of the Wnt signaling pathway in a tissue-specific manner. Thus, while Rspo3 deficiency in osteoprogenitor cells increases bone mass in the appendicular skeleton, it causes osteopenia of vertebral bone. The study therefore not only identifies RSPO3, variants of which are associated with bone density in people, as a target for enhancing bone density in fracture-prone appendicular sites in the aging population, but also brings forth caution in the interpretation of single-site studies of the skeleton in most general terms.
